text: Claims must be submitted within 90 days of the date of service. Reimbursement is the lesser of billed charges or the applicable fee schedule amount. Covered services are paid at 100% of the Medicare Physician Fee Schedule.
Provider shall submit all claims no later than 120 days from the date of service. Payment shall be 110% of the current Medicare allowable amount.
Timely filing limit: 180 days. The plan reimburses the lesser of the provider's billed charges or 95% of Medicare.
All claims must be received within sixty (60) days of service. Services are reimbursed at 115% of the Medicare fee schedule.
Claims are payable if filed within 365 days of the date of service. Reimbursement equals the lesser of charges or the fee schedule. Rate: 100% of Medicare.
The Provider must file claims within 30 days. Payment is set at 85% of the Medicare rate.
Submission deadline is 90 days from the service date. The lesser-of provision (billed charges versus fee schedule) applies. Reimbursement: 120% of Medicare.
Claims filed after 45 days from the date of service will be denied. The plan pays 130% of the Medicare allowable.
Timely filing: claims must be submitted within 90 days. Reimbursement shall not exceed the lesser of billed charges or 100% of the Medicare fee schedule.
Provider agrees to submit claims within 150 days of service. Payment is 90% of Medicare. No lesser-of provision applies.
Effective for dates of service on or after this amendment, the timely filing window is 270 days. Reimbursement is the lesser of charges or the fee schedule at 105% of Medicare.
Claims must be received within 75 days. The agreement reimburses 112.5% of the Medicare physician fee schedule.
